description: A professional dermatologist-inspired night routine designed to nourish and repair normal skin overnight.

night_steps.action: Cleanse the face gently with a hydrating cleanser
night_steps.purpose: Remove impurities and prepare the skin for further treatment

night_steps.action: Apply a lightweight toner to balance pH levels
night_steps.purpose: Rehydrate the skin and restore its natural barrier function

night_steps.action: Moisturize with a non-greasy, hydrating cream or gel
night_steps.purpose: Lock in moisture and provide long-lasting hydration throughout the night

night_steps.action: Apply a retinol serum for cell turnover and rejuvenation (2-3 times per week)
night_steps.purpose: Promote skin renewal, reduce fine lines, and improve texture

night_steps.action: Protect the skin with a broad-spectrum SPF moisturizer in the morning
night_steps.purpose: Prevent sun damage and maintain youthful appearance

weekly_steps.action: Exfoliate gently using a chemical exfoliant containing AHAs or BHAs

dont: Do not over-exfoliate; it can lead to irritation and skin damage.
Avoid heavy creams that may clog pores overnight.
common_mistakes: Using too many products, which can overload the skin and cause irritation
Overusing retinol without proper guidance from a dermatologist

expected_results.2_weeks: Skin should appear more hydrated and less flaky.
expected_results.1_month: Fine lines may become less noticeable, and skin texture should improve.
expected_results.3_months: Improved overall skin tone and a smoother appearance.

expert_tips: Patch test new products before fully incorporating them into your routine to ensure compatibility with your skin
Stay consistent but listen to your skin; if something doesn't work, don’t hesitate to adjust
